nodes.name: Establishing Shared Query Understanding in an Open Multi-Agent System
Ontology Alignment
nodes.description: Studies how systems with different formal representations of their knowledge can communicate successfully by suggesting concept or instance alignments.

nodes.name: Language Games
nodes.description: An approach to establish successful communication in an open multi-agent system only via grounded communication.

nodes.name: Interactive Reinforcement Learning
nodes.description: Studies problems where the reward signal is sparse and incorporates human input to make convergence faster.

nodes.name: Ontology Alignment benchmark
nodes.description: An established ontology alignment benchmark modified for designing experiments for cooperative query answering.

nodes.name: precision
nodes.description: Used as a trade-off measure alongside efficiency for task achievement.

nodes.name: recall
nodes.description: Used as a trade-off measure alongside efficiency for task achievement.

nodes.name: number of interactions
nodes.description: Principal efficiency metric measured in terms of number of interactions or examples that agents exchange.

nodes.name: cognitive load
nodes.description: Example case-specific metric to evaluate shared understanding using the proposed framework.

nodes.name: memory demands
nodes.description: Measured in episodic memory and working memory sizes in number of memorized episodes and variables used respectively.

nodes.name: Open Multi-Agent Systems
nodes.description: A field where agents from a diverse population, that do not have an established communication protocol, need to learn how to communicate only via grounded interaction.

nodes.name: Cooperative Query Answering
nodes.description: A task where two agents need to collectively answer a query while representing different databases defined in their own ontologies.

nodes.name: Grounded Interaction
nodes.description: Communication via examples that consist of common instances for which agents are expected to have similar knowledge.

nodes.name: Successful communication establishment
nodes.description: Experiments demonstrate successful communication establishment under the required restrictions using only a very limited number of interactions.

nodes.name: Robust query understanding performance
nodes.description: A robust query understanding method can be expected to perform better in a scenario where the agents have incomplete knowledge of their environment.

nodes.name: Informative examples interpretation
nodes.description: Examples that seem to be more informative are more probable to be interpreted differently by the two agents.
